items.title: The TL;DR on Figma Weave: Make your creative process repeatable
items.excerpt: Figma explains what Figma Weave unlocks for creative teams: node-based, reusable AI generation workflows on the canvas, and how to get the most out of them.

items.title: Vercel MCP now renders deployments as an interactive card
items.excerpt: Vercel MCP now renders interactive deployment cards in MCP Apps clients like ChatGPT, letting users track status, view build logs and debug deployments in chat - a live example of generative/agent UI via MCP Apps.

items.title: Context is the new interface
items.excerpt: Aurelie Radom argues that as AI agents interpret intent and carry it across apps using on-screen context, the designer's job shifts from single-app screens to designing what happens between products.

items.title: Your design system was never about components
items.excerpt: Google, Atlassian and Figma now ship markdown files that capture the reasons behind a design for AI agents to read; Takuma Kakehi examines why nothing yet makes the machine actually follow them.

items.title: "Use their tools against them": why AI isn't the death of production design
items.excerpt: Industry veteran Christopher Glass answers how designers entering production design should approach AI tools they feel economically forced to use. (Opinion/interview - lower priority.)

items.title: New CG software you may have missed: 2 November 2026 (Character Creator 5.2 AI 3D model generator)
items.excerpt: Reallusion's Character Creator 5.2 adds an AI 3D model generator that builds characters, clothing and hair from reference images using Tripo P2.0/H3.1 and Hunyuan V3.1, plus a generative concept-design module and CC Wrap.

items.title: Claude Code Now Refuses to Recreate Existing Video Games
items.excerpt: A new Claude Code rule stops the model from rebuilding specific existing games, but developers say it also blocks their own projects and some reverse-engineering tasks.

items.title: Anthropic clamps down on Claude's AI video game clones
items.excerpt: Anthropic says infringing IP is against its usage policy and has updated Claude to refuse recreating existing video games. (Same story as 80 Level item.)

items.title: Build World Models for Interactive Simulation with NVIDIA Cosmos
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details a Cosmos framework for adapting world models to sensors, tasks and data and deploying them into interactive simulation applications for physical AI.

items.title: Nemetschek expands AI tools across building workflows
items.excerpt: Nemetschek's Max lineup - Archicad Max, Allplan Max and Bluebeam Max - puts AI assistants on a shared AI and data platform across design, engineering and construction. (Allplan Max covered 11-02; this is the group-wide Archicad/Bluebeam expansion.)

items.title: What I learned from 45 years of CAD development: Doing more with less
items.excerpt: John M. Christy rewrote his 45-year-old CAD program for Mac with Claude as co-developer - now drafting from speech - and reflects on what AI should and shouldn't change in CAD.

items.title: The home brew estate: Q&A with AMC Bridge
items.excerpt: With AI, making AEC software is easy, but making it safe, supportable and accountable is another matter; AMC Bridge on firms vibe-coding their own design tools.

items.title: 'VRChat' Faces User Backlash After Rejecting 'AI-Generated' Content Label
items.excerpt: VRChat is weathering a sizable user backlash after deciding not to label AI-generated avatars, worlds and content, following a community survey on AI disclosure.

items.title: I built an AI Tamagotchi before Meta could
items.excerpt: The Verge's Sean Hollister vibe-coded an AI companion gadget on a Waveshare ESP32 board with Claude, prototyping hardware product design without being a programmer.

items.title: Runway Dev is in Claude Code, Codex and Cursor
